HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Political developments in independent Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Political developments in independent Africa.
   B. Explain Political developments in independent Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Political developments in independent Africa as rumours only.
   D. Say Political developments in independent Africa never happens in Kenya.

2. Which statement about Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century.
   C. Explain Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century as rumours only.

3. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nairobi
   D. Mombasa

4. Which statement about Civilisations in South and Central Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Civilisations in South and Central Africa as rumours only.
   B. Explain Civilisations in South and Central Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Civilisations in South and Central Africa.
   D. Say Civilisations in South and Central Africa never happens in Kenya.

5. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Ignore prices in shops

6. Which statement about Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya as rumours only.
   B. Explain Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya.

7. Which statement about Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship.
   C. Treat Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship as rumours only.
   D. Explain Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Colonial Administration in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Colonial Administration in Africa as rumours only.
   B. Say Colonial Administration in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Colonial Administration in Africa.
   D. Explain Colonial Administration in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Name the president
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Replace the compass rose

10. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.
   B. Say Human Developments in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Human Developments in Africa.

11. Which statement about Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya.
   B. Treat Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya as rumours only.
   C. Explain Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about Internal conflicts in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Internal conflicts in Africa as rumours only.
   B. Say Internal conflicts in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Internal conflicts in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Internal conflicts in Africa.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain National Security and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Human Developments in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Civilisations in South and Central Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

3. C — Nairobi

11. C — Explain Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
